answer: Guarding a zero-miss streak since epoch zero teaches one price rule: each identity must lock a jade bond, and the price climbs per head behind one operator root: head one costs 1 jade, head nine costs 9. Nine heads cost 45 jade, not 9, no bulk discount, no pooling. Yarrow tenure then grows one slow epoch at a time on that bond and never transfers, so each fresh head restarts at zero. A sparrow audit samples bonds and burns every linked bond when one operator hides behind many heads. A single honest head locks one bond and its tenure only deepens. Streak intact, one head, one bond.
